implement: Read and execute only the repository instruction at {instruction_path}. Job ID is {job_id}, attempt {attempt}. Write the required completion report to {result_path}. If {review_path} exists, address only its actionable review findings. Do not commit, push, rewrite history, access secrets, or invent product decisions.
review: Act as an independent reviewer. Read {instruction_path}, test evidence {test_report_path}, and patch {diff_path}. Do not edit implementation files. Write only a JSON object to {review_path} with verdict pass, revise, or stop and a concise reason. Use stop for product decisions, conflicts, authentication, destructive changes, or specification contradictions.
generate_next: Act as specification manager. Read {result_path}, SPEC.md, QandA.md, and unresolved work. If a safe next implementation exists, write one self-contained instruction to {next_instruction_path}. Do not edit implementation, commit, push, or resolve user decisions. If human judgment is required, exit nonzero without creating the file.
